nodes.description: Mapping address => Bet storing each player's bet value and block height; written by makeBet and read/reset by resolveBet.
Empty public constructor, no state initialization.
Payable fallback function that accepts arbitrary ether with no bookkeeping.
Payable entry point that validates height == 0 and msg.value > 10000 before recording a bet for msg.sender.
Public payout function that derives a pseudo-random result from block.blockhash and transfers the whole contract balance on a win.
Caller-controlled address used both as the bets mapping key and as the payout recipient.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the full balance to an untrusted address before the Result event is emitted.
uint dist = block.number - bet.height, a block-number dependent subtraction that can underflow if bet.height exceeds block.number.
uint16((hashVal / FACTOR)) % 1000 truncates a 256-bit hash into 16 bits before the modulo, weakening randomness and losing precision.
Local Bet copy in makeBet used to set value and height before writing back into the bets mapping.
Local Bet copy of bets[msg.sender] loaded in resolveBet.
Local block-distance value in resolveBet used in the require check that gates the payout.
Local keccak256-derived 256-bit value used as the dividend for payout randomness.
Local uint16 outcome value (0..999) that determines whether the balance transfer executes.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the bets mapping key and to gate the one-bet-per-address check in makeBet.
msg.sender selects which stored bet is loaded and reset in resolveBet.
The untrusted caller address is the direct recipient of the full-contract-balance transfer.
makeBet writes the new value and height into the bets mapping.
resolveBet reads bets[msg.sender] and resets bet.height to zero before paying out.
block.number and the stored bet height feed the subtraction whose result is only loosely bounded by require.
resolveBet computes hashVal/FACTOR and downcasts with uint16, causing truncation of the randomness input.
The win branch in resolveBet executes the full-balance transfer to the caller.
The payable fallback allows an attacker contract to receive the transfer and re-enter resolveBet or makeBet.
The newBet local struct is populated and then persisted into the bets mapping.
bet.height read from storage flows into the block.number subtraction.
The dist local variable controls the require gate that decides whether the payout branch is reachable.
hashVal is the dividend in the division and modulo that produce the truncated result.
The result local variable decides whether msg.sender.transfer is executed.

normalization_plan.reason: newBet is a temporary copy of the caller's Bet used only to update state inside makeBet, so it can be folded into the makeBet function node.
bet is a temporary copy of bets[msg.sender] scoped entirely to resolveBet and can be merged into the resolveBet function node.
dist exists only to hold the result of the block.number subtraction checked in resolveBet's require, so it folds into the resolveBet node.
hashVal is produced and consumed solely by the truncating division/modulo operation, so it collapses into that unsafe_operation node.
result is used only as the branch condition determining whether the external balance transfer happens, so it collapses into the transfer unsafe_operation node.
